answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 8136 Country: India Title: Is tobacco smoking or chewing in islam is haram? kindly answer with refrence. Question: Is tobacco smoking or chewing in islam is haram? kindly answer with refrence. zazakallah Answer ID: 8136 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1054/1054=M/1429) The tobacco which causes intoxication is haram as the Hadith says: every intoxicant is haram. But, the tobacco which is smelly (not intoxicant) it is makrooh (undesirable) while one which is free from intoxication and bad smell is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
